title: Kook Chat
description: This mod can link Kook and Minecraft.
body:
**Kook Chat (Beta)**  
*Bridges KooK & Minecraft!*  

- Syncs chat messages seamlessly via API  
- Use `/kook-link` to check real-time connection status  
- Features encrypted messaging for secure communication  

> ⚠️ **Beta** – Now in testing. Feedback welcome!
